senses.zh_definition: 蝰蛇；蝰科的有毒蛇类，包括蝮蛇类。
senses.en_definition: A venomous snake of the family Viperidae, including pit vipers.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi ular berbisa daripada famili Viperidae, termasuk kumpulan ular kapak.
senses.nuances: 输入没有 DBP 释义，本条按英语动物名称及马来西亚双语使用情境解释；不能据此宣称已核实其为 DBP 正式马来语词目。status 按指定格式保留。马来文释义为编写性释义，非 DBP 引文；本地 pit viper 常称 ular kapak。英语读音见 [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/viper)，本地名称对应见 [MyBIS](https://www.mybis.gov.my/sp/57443)。以下搭配保留英语名称形式。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam bahan penerangan dwibahasa itu, ular kapak bodoh disenaraikan dengan nama Inggeris Malayan pit viper.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该双语说明材料将马来亚蝮蛇列于其英语名称 Malayan pit viper 之下。
dual_scenarios.en: The bilingual information material lists ular kapak bodoh under its English name, Malayan pit viper.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kat papan tu tulis pit viper. Ular kapak ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pada papan itu tertulis pit viper. Adakah itu ular kapak?
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个牌子写着 pit viper，是说蝮蛇吗？
dual_scenarios.en: That sign says pit viper. Is that an ular kapak?

etymology.historical_story: English viper comes through French or Latin vipera. A traditional explanation connects the Latin name with words meaning alive and bring forth, referring to live birth. This records an old naming explanation rather than a universal biological rule. In Malaysian bilingual animal descriptions, English viper names occur alongside local names such as ular kapak. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/viper).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先按英语读作 /ˈvaɪpə(r)/，联想张口露毒牙的蝰蛇；马来西亚常见对应词组是 ular kapak，别把 viper 当成所有毒蛇的统称。
